theorem prime_dvd_iff_power_mul_factor_modEq_zero
    (n a : ℤ) (p e : ℕ) (hp : Nat.Prime p) (he_pos : 0 < e)
    (hfactor : ¬ ((↑p : ℤ) ∣ a)) :
    (↑p : ℤ) ∣ n ↔ n ^ e * a ≡ 0 [ZMOD p] := by
  rw [Int.modEq_zero_iff_dvd]
  constructor
  · intro h
    have he_eq : e = (e - 1) + 1 := by omega
    have h_n_dvd_pow : n ∣ n ^ e := by
      rw [he_eq, pow_succ]
      exact dvd_mul_left n (n ^ (e - 1))
    exact dvd_mul_of_dvd_left (dvd_trans h h_n_dvd_pow) a
  · intro h
    have hprime : Prime (↑p : ℤ) := by
      first
      | rw [Int.prime_iff_natAbs_prime, Int.natAbs_natCast]; exact hp
      | exact_mod_cast hp
      | rwa [Nat.prime_iff_prime_int] at hp
    have h_or : (↑p : ℤ) ∣ n ^ e ∨ (↑p : ℤ) ∣ a := hprime.dvd_mul.mp h
    rcases h_or with h_pow | h_a
    · have key : ∀ k : ℕ, (↑p : ℤ) ∣ n ^ (k + 1) → (↑p : ℤ) ∣ n := by
        intro k
        induction k with
        | zero => simpa
        | succ k ih =>
          intro hk
          rw [pow_succ] at hk
          rcases hprime.dvd_mul.mp hk with h1 | h2
          · exact ih h1
          · exact h2
      have he_eq : e = (e - 1) + 1 := by omega
      rw [he_eq] at h_pow
      exact key (e - 1) h_pow
    · exact absurd h_a hfactor

import Mathlib

set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
set_option autoImplicit false
open BigOperators Real Nat Topology Rat

theorem prime_dvd_iff_power_mul_factor_modEq_zero
    (n a : ℤ) (p e : ℕ) (hp : Nat.Prime p) (he_pos : 0 < e)
    (hfactor : ¬ ((↑p : ℤ) ∣ a)) :
    (↑p : ℤ) ∣ n ↔ n ^ e * a ≡ 0 [ZMOD p] := by
  have hpz : Prime (p : ℤ) := by
    apply Int.prime_iff_natAbs_prime.mpr
    simpa using hp
  
  have he_ne : e ≠ 0 := Nat.ne_of_gt he_pos
  
  have pow_dvd :
      ∀ k : ℕ, (p : ℤ) ∣ n ^ k → (p : ℤ) ∣ n := by
    intro k
    induction k with
    | zero =>
        intro h
        have hone : (p : ℤ) ∣ (1 : ℤ) := by
          simpa using h
        exact (hpz.not_dvd_one hone).elim
    | succ k ih =>
        intro h
        have hmul : (p : ℤ) ∣ n ^ k * n := by
          simpa [pow_succ] using h
        rcases hpz.dvd_mul.mp hmul with hpow | hn
        · exact ih hpow
        · exact hn
  
  constructor
  · intro hn
    apply (Int.modEq_zero_iff_dvd).2
    have hpow : (p : ℤ) ∣ n ^ e := by
      cases e with
      | zero =>
          exact (he_ne rfl).elim
      | succ k =>
          rw [pow_succ]
          exact dvd_mul_of_dvd_right hn _
    exact dvd_mul_of_dvd_left hpow a
  · intro hmod
    have hprod : (p : ℤ) ∣ n ^ e * a :=
      (Int.modEq_zero_iff_dvd).1 hmod
    rcases hpz.dvd_mul.mp hprod with hpow | ha
    · exact pow_dvd e hpow
    · exact (hfactor ha).elim
